stations.title: Odette
stations.say: Can the hall's page show what's on?

stations.title: Village hall page
stations.text: Its script asks the cupboard server.

stations.title: Cupboard server
stations.text: Answers, but names no page that may read.

captions: Odette asks if the village hall's page can show what is playing, for trusted pages only.
The hall's script asks the cupboard server, and the browser keeps the answer from it.
You compare origins and write the browser's rules and the server's, in five tasks.
The hall's page shows the song now playing, and pages nobody trusts still cannot.
The repo is done: from one request to copies, cookies and pages that share answers safely.
